decks.notes: The main concept of this deck is to aggressively deploy a mix of low-cost creatures, such as Iron-Shield Elf and Marauding Mako, alongside powerful spells like Carnage, Crimson Chaos and Requiting Hex to quickly overwhelm the opponent. The mana base is built around both white and red sources to support the spells in the deck. This Mardu Aggro deck aims to apply constant pressure on the opponent, leveraging the synergies between its creatures and spells to secure a quick victory.

The main idea of this deck is to quickly fill the graveyard with powerful creatures and then bring them back onto the battlefield using reanimation spells. By utilizing a combination of card draw, discard, and protection, the deck aims to overwhelm the opponent with a sudden influx of strong creatures. The deck also includes some control elements to disrupt the opponent's plans while steadily working towards the combo finish. The key strategy is to efficiently fill the graveyard and then capitalize on that resource to take control of the game.

The main concept of this Dimir Aggro deck is to overwhelm the opponent with a combination of aggressive creatures and disruptive spells. By utilizing cards like Bitter Triumph and Shoot the Sheriff to control the board, along with powerful creatures like Kaito, Bane of Nightmares and Spyglass Siren to apply pressure, the deck aims to quickly take control of the game. Enduring Curiosity provides card advantage, while Restless Reef and Soulstone Sanctuary offer additional protection and resilience. The deck's strategy revolves around maintaining a strong board presence while disrupting the opponent's game plan.

The main focus of this Grixis Control deck is to disrupt the opponent's game plan with a combination of hand disruption spells like Duress and Dead Cover-Up, while also controlling the board with removal spells such as Abrade and Bitter Triumph. The deck runs a variety of powerful finishers like Avengers Disassembled and Thor, God of Thunder to close out the game. Additionally, the deck utilizes powerful lands such as Multiversal Passage and Great Hall of the Biblioplex to fix mana and generate card advantage.

The deck focuses on utilizing a combination of aggressive creatures and disruption spells to control the board and put pressure on the opponent. By deploying efficient creatures like Infestation Sage and Floodpits Drowner, as well as spells like Requiting Hex and Shoot the Sheriff, the deck aims to maintain board control and chip away at the opponent's life total quickly. Additionally, cards like Enduring Curiosity and Kaito, Bane of Nightmares provide card advantage and additional threats to overwhelm the opponent. The deck's strategy is to maintain a high tempo and close out the game swiftly.

The main concept of this deck is to be aggressive and quickly overwhelm your opponent with a combination of evasive creatures and disruptive spells. The deck focuses on controlling the board with counterspells like Spell Pierce and Spell Snare, while also providing threats like Kaito, Bane of Nightmares and Spyglass Siren to pressure your opponent. The inclusion of cards like Requiting Hex and Shoot the Sheriff provide additional removal options, allowing you to maintain tempo and disrupt your opponent's game plan while pushing your own advantage.

The main concept of this deck is to overwhelm the opponent with a mix of aggressive creatures and spells, focusing on a fast-paced playstyle. By using a combination of low-cost creatures like Bloodghast and Marauding Mako, along with powerful spells like Requiting Hex and Erode, the deck aims to quickly chip away at the opponent's life total and secure victory. Additionally, cards like Moonshadow and Cool but Rude provide additional support and flexibility in combat situations. The strategy revolves around maintaining board presence and applying constant pressure to the opponent.

This deck focuses on quickly developing a strong board presence using low-cost creatures and ramping up mana with cards like Llanowar Elves. It makes use of cards like Earthbender Ascension and Sapling Nursery to pump up your creatures and overwhelm your opponent. Surrak, Elusive Hunter and Keen-Eyed Curator provide additional threats, while cards like Royal Treatment and Demolition Field offer removal options. The deck also includes some utility lands like Ba Sing Se and Escape Tunnel to protect your creatures and ensure stable mana production. Overall, the strategy is to swarm the board and maintain pressure on the opponent.

This control deck focuses on card advantage, resource management, and board control to outlast opponents. Using powerful card draw and removal spells, along with versatile lands and protection spells, the deck aims to maintain control of the game until it can unleash a devastating finisher like Jeskai Revelation or North Wind Avatar. The deck also includes disruptive spells like Negate and Get Lost to disrupt the opponent's game plan, while also providing ways to refill the hand and stabilize the board through cards like Stock Up and Day of Judgment.

The main concept of this deck is to use fast mana ramp with cards like Llanowar Elves and Fabled Passage to quickly bring out powerful creatures like Surrak, Elusive Hunter and Lumbering Worldwagon. The deck aims to overwhelm the opponent with a flurry of aggressive creatures like Sazh's Chocobo and Icetill Explorer, while also utilizing cards like Royal Treatment and Keen-Eyed Curator for additional utility and card advantage. The deck also includes cards like Meltstrider's Resolve and Mightform Harmonizer to protect and buff its creatures, ultimately aiming to establish a dominant board presence and finish the game quickly.

This deck focuses on quickly overwhelming the opponent with aggressive creatures and using disruptive spells to control the game. By playing efficient creatures like Deep-Cavern Bat and Hinterland Sanctifier, along with powerful spells like Erode and Case of the Uneaten Feast, the deck can apply pressure early and maintain it throughout the game. The inclusion of cards like Clarion Conqueror and Starscape Cleric provides additional utility and versatility, while cards like Lunar Convocation and Shattered Sanctum help to generate card advantage and keep the deck running smoothly.

The main concept of this deck is to focus on controlling the opponent's resources and slowing down their game plan. Cards like Negate, Essence Scatter, and Spell Snare provide disruption to opposing spells, while Stock Up and Consult the Star Charts help dig for key cards. Three Steps Ahead and Deadly Cover-Up offer ways to deal with threats on the board. The deck also includes mana fixing with dual lands like Watery Grave and Gloomlake Verge. Overall, the goal is to outlast the opponent and control the pace of the game until a win condition can be established.

This deck focuses on utilizing a combination of aggressive creatures and disruptive spells to quickly overwhelm the opponent. By playing efficient threats like Dream Beavers and Floodpits Drowner, combined with control elements like Requiting Hex and Shoot the Sheriff, the deck aims to disrupt the opponent's game plan while applying pressure. Hidden Lair and Soulstone Sanctuary provide additional resilience and card advantage. The inclusion of cards like Bitter Triumph and Enduring Curiosity helps to maintain momentum and ensure a steady stream of threats. Overall, the deck is designed to be proactive and relentless in its pursuit of victory.

The main concept of this Jeskai Control deck is to control the game through a combination of card draw, removal spells, and powerful late-game threats like Thor, God of Thunder. The deck includes a variety of spells that can help generate card advantage, disrupt the opponent's game plan, and provide flexibility in different situations. By managing resources effectively and playing patiently, this deck aims to outlast opponents and eventually overwhelm them with powerful spells and creatures. It also utilizes lands that can generate multiple colors of mana to support its diverse spell options.

This Selesnya Aggro deck focuses on overwhelming the opponent with a combination of efficient creatures and combat tricks. By utilizing powerful creatures like Brightglass Gearhulk and Surrak, Elusive Hunter, alongside cards like Practiced Offense and Bushwhack, the deck aims to quickly build a strong board presence and aggressively attack the opponent. With a mix of creature buffs, card draw, and mana ramp, this deck is designed to put pressure on the opponent early in the game and maintain that momentum to secure a swift victory.

The deck focuses on utilizing powerful combo cards and reanimating creatures from the graveyard to overwhelm the opponent. By using cards like Emeritus of Ideation and Superior Spider-Man, along with spells like Requiting Hex and Day of Black Sun, the deck aims to create a strong board presence and outvalue the opponent. The inclusion of cards like Duress and Deadly Cover-Up helps to disrupt the opponent's strategy while strategic plays with cards like Strategic Betrayal can turn the tide of the game in your favor. The deck's flexibility and graveyard manipulation are key to its success.
